hints: A stationary point satisfies $dy/dx=0$, so differentiate the product $e^{-2x}\ln(x-1)$.
Use the product and chain rules to obtain two terms with a common factor $e^{-2x}$.
Set the derivative to zero, cancel the non-zero exponential, and rearrange to $\ln(x-1)=1/[2(x-1)]$.
Exponentiate and isolate $x$ to reach the required fixed-point form.
walkthrough:
Differentiate $y = \mathrm{e}^{-2x}\ln(x - 1)$ with respect to $x$ using the product rule $(uv)' = u'v + uv'$ with $u = \mathrm{e}^{-2x}$ and $v = \ln(x - 1)$:
$$u' = -2\mathrm{e}^{-2x}, \quad v' = \dfrac{1}{x - 1}$$

At the stationary point $x = p$, set $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = 0$. Since $\mathrm{e}^{-2p} \neq 0$:
$$-2\ln(p - 1) + \dfrac{1}{p - 1} = 0$$
$$2\ln(p - 1) = \dfrac{1}{p - 1}$$
$$\ln(p - 1) = \dfrac{1}{2(p - 1)}$$

Exponentiate both sides with base $\mathrm{e}$:
$$p - 1 = \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(p - 1)}\right)$$
$$p = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(p - 1)}\right)$$
This confirms that $p$ satisfies the given equation.

walkthrough:
Conclude using the intermediate value theorem:
Since $\mathrm{f}(x)$ is continuous on $[2.2, 2.6]$ and changes sign (from negative at $x = 2.2$ to positive at $x = 2.6$), the equation has a root $p$ lying between $2.2$ and $2.6$.

Choose a starting value in the verified interval $2.2<p<2.6$ and display every iterate to 4 decimal places.
Continue until successive values determine the same result to 2 decimal places.
walkthrough:
Set up the iterative formula based on part (i):
$$p_{n+1} = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(p_n - 1)}\right)$$

Compute successive iterations to 4 decimal places:
- $p_2 = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(2.4 - 1)}\right) = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2.8}\right) = 1 + \exp(0.357143) \approx 2.4292$
- $p_3 = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(2.4292 - 1)}\right) = 1 + \exp(0.349846) \approx 2.4188$
- $p_4 = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(2.4188 - 1)}\right) \approx 2.4225$
- $p_5 = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(2.4225 - 1)}\right) \approx 2.4212$
- $p_6 = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(2.4212 - 1)}\right) \approx 2.4216$
- $p_7 = 1 + \exp\left(\dfrac{1}{2(2.4216 - 1)}\right) \approx 2.4215$

Observe convergence to $2.4215$.
Round to 2 decimal places:
$$p \approx 2.42$$
